note: Clayton County Conservation park in a limestone-bluff valley along Bloody Run, an Iowa Outstanding Water trout stream, just W of Marquette, next to the 909-acre Bloody Run State Wildlife Area. Primitive sites in two areas: 1-12 in an open meadow by the park road, 13-20 farther down the valley by the railroad. One RV or trailer per site, quiet generators allowed; no pad length posted. An active rail line runs through the park and trains sound their horns. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 20 primitive sites, $15, one RV/trailer per site. Corrected: booking was 'FCFS only' (now online 3 days ahead, then day-of registration; weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums), season was 'May-Oct' (closes week of Nov 1, opens April); site count and $4 fee added. Waterfront downgrade lead (creekside -> not waterfront).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down, creekside -> not waterfront): the county's own site aerials put sites 1-12 in the open meadow west of the park road, with that road, buildings and a treed strip between them and Bloody Run, which runs about 60-120 m east (NAIP). Sites 13-20 sit by the railroad and a gravel lane in woods; the creek bends around 13-16 within roughly 30-60 m but behind trees and the lane, and I can't confirm open ground to the water. The creek is about 5-10 m wide. The stored creekside rests only on a commit note. Unsure after every source, so down (at best creekview for 13-16).
BOOKING WAS WRONG: stored reservable false / fcfs always; the county now takes online reservations 3 days ahead, with walk-up day-of registration on unreserved sites.
SEASON WAS WRONG in the note: it said 'May-Oct (closed Nov-Apr)'; the county says the gates close the week of Nov 1 and it typically opens in April.
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: sites allow 'one RV or one trailer'; no pad length posted. The 1-12 meadow sites are open grass off a gravel lane.
PIN OK: 43.04430,-91.21270 is in the sites 1-12 meadow. Phone 563-245-1516 matches the county office.
